title: Steamed Spotted Dick
description: A classic British dessert made with suet and dried fruit, steamed to perfection.
instructions: Preheat a steamer basket over boiling water.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, dried fruit, suet, and spices.
Add the egg, milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract, and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5-10 minutes, until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Shape the dough into a log and wrap in parchment paper.
Place the log in the steamer basket and steam for 45-50 minutes, or until the cake is cooked through.
Remove the cake from the steamer and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
